description: Authenticates email sent through mailfor.dev (Amazon SES): a DKIM key, the MAIL FROM subdomain (MX for bounces and SPF), and optionally a DMARC policy.
variableDescription: %dkimSelector%: DKIM selector generated per domain (e.g. sm1a2b3c). %dkimKey%: base64 RSA public key for that selector. %region%: AWS SES region (e.g. us-east-2). %dmarcRua%: DMARC aggregate report URI (e.g. mailto:dmarc@example.com); the dmarc group is applied only when the domain has no DMARC record.

records.data: v=DMARC1; p=none; adkim=s; aspf=s; sp=reject; fo=1; rua=%dmarcRua%
